speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing agitation, yellowing of your skin and eyes, and abnormal lab results; tell me, have you noticed any recent changes in your urine color, such as it becoming dark like tea or cola?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis likely due to Hepatitis C or HIV coinfection, potentially exacerbated by recent substance use. I have already noted his history and symptoms; given the yellowing of skin and eyes (jaundice) and agitation, further testing is required to confirm the cause. REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Panel, Complete Blood Count, Hepatitis A/B/C Serology, HIV Antibody/Antigen, and Toxicology Screen.
